subplayer.release_notes: v1.3.4: Up/Down arrow keys now step through the sample list — the list scrolls to keep the selected sample visible and each step previews the sample just like clicking it.

lock.release_notes: First release. Automatic vocal alignment: always listening, captures on vocal, aligns dubs to the lead. Never mutes your live vocal.

looplab.release_notes: v1.5.3: Full clean rebuild — fixes v1.5.2 shipping with stale 1.5.1 binary. Category tabs use 2-letter initials (Sl/Bl/Dl/Hl/Pl/Vl); VocalLoops category; bit-exact drag-out export; DC offset removal on load.

hub.release_notes: v1.0.3: Removed Loop Lab from the catalog — it was uninstalled after preventing LUNA from loading. Hub now shows Sub-Player Pro only. Loop Lab is hidden behind #if 0 in the source for easy restore when the LUNA issue is resolved.
